title: PACKETLOSS Powerups
status: Powerup GLBs are the canonical geometry and animation source for gameplay and the Asset Lab; magnet remains preview-only.

coordinates.units: Existing game world units; no import rescale required.
coordinates.root: Stationary at ground origin; animate descendants only.

playback.oneshots: Use LoopOnce and clampWhenFinished; remove expired effects after clip duration.
playback.clock: Drive from the same paused/scaled game presentation clock.
playback.blend: Packet companion cast poses start and end neutral; use a short ease when blending poses.

sourceExport.sceneName: Set scene name to entry.clip for export.

materials.textures: None; self-contained mesh, material and transform/morph animation.
materials.transparency: Soft shells use standard alpha blend. Keep depthWrite disabled on transparent materials, as GLTFLoader does.
materials.bloom: Optional only. Review images use no compositor bloom.
materials.layers: Keep emissive surfaces and transparent shells in their authored order; do not flatten all materials to opaque.

integration.magnet: Automatic after collection. Point attraction only. Loop magnet-field with packet-magnet while active. Rendered star motes are decorative; gameplay must move actual point instances.
integration.blast: Play packet-blast and blast-burst directly at the same age. The GLB shock front follows the 64-unit cubic damage envelope from 0.45 to 1.2 s and retires at 1.6 s; no runtime replacement effect.
integration.reverse-blast: Play packet-reverse-blast and reverse-blast-vortex directly at the same age. A lethal 64-unit pulse releases at 0.35 s; a soft dark well contracts to nothing by 1.1 s without further hits or opponent displacement.
integration.laser: Play packet-laser and laser-beam at the same age. Hold the Packet through 1.8 s. The GLB contains beam growth, DNA, and contact particles. Runtime adapts only the laser-span length and impact placement to the first solid wall, with straight off-map travel through open portals.
integration.missile: Trace uses the compatible missile key and filenames. Play the one-second packet-missile and missile-launch clips directly while following the moving Packet and its heading. Hold the final assembly pose until authoritative release, then reveal missile-flight at the same origin. Root motion and collision remain gameplay-owned; impact is a harmless visual burst.
integration.collection: Use each kind-collect for a local pickup absorption preview: 0.18 s intake + 0.12 s pulse. The target is above the Packet top face. Runtime must adapt position/trajectory from the actual collected location.
integration.packetCompanion: Runtime applies the authored packet-pose and eye transform curves to the existing procedural HologramPacket, preserving player color and appearance. Companion body and eye meshes remain hidden while charge decorations follow the player.
integration.runtimeLoading: PowerupAssets and PowerupPreviewAssets both play the canonical GLBs through PowerupModel. Authored geometry, colors, and clip timing are shared; only placement, aiming, beam reach, and companion pose retargeting depend on gameplay.

review.note: Pickup, effect and Packet rows use different display scales. Review animation repeats clips independently; exported one-shots do not loop.

assets.notes: Decorative bits show inward motion; runtime supplies real collected points.
